records.key_findings: The exact ChatGPT/SBIC benchmark context resolves to Social Bias Inference Corpus, not Japanese SBIC East Japan. The 65.9% GPT-3.5 figure is pairwise human preference over gold explanations, not accuracy; GPT-4 scored 60.6%. A secondary review mis-expands SBIC as a COVID-19 corpus and conflates the gold reference with political ideology; primary sources disconfirm it. Permission Coin ASK is a plausible but unconfirmed ASK Coin candidate; current official positioning is family-friendly AI and ASK rewards, explicitly not an investment product. ASK is an OFT on Base and Polygon; Base is Coinbase-incubated, creating only an indirect network relationship. No direct XRP/XRPL integration was found. CMC and CoinGecko ASK prices/supplies/volumes materially disagree and order-book depth is extremely thin.
